results.title: r/FoundryVTT on Reddit: Prototype Card Engine for Foundry
results.snippet: I'm building a personal board game / journaling game for Foundry and in the course of doing that ended-up building a card system. It's extremely rudimentary and prototypey at the moment, and has some project-specific things that are likely to be annoying to anyone just looking for a card system, but I figured I'd share it here in case anyone wants to fork it / build on top of it / whatever.
